subject: Hospitality
title: The Future Hotel
description: A quick win: understand The Future Hotel.

hook.text: Hotels of the future might have no front desk, no room keys, and AI that knows your preferences before you arrive.

buildup.text: Modular construction could build hotels in weeks instead of years. Robot staff could handle cleaning and deliveries.

discovery.text: Space hotels are being planned. Orbital Reef and Voyager Station aim to host guests in low Earth orbit by the 2030s.

twist.text: Despite all the tech, research shows the #1 factor in guest satisfaction is still human kindness. Technology can't replace that.

climax.text: The hotel of the future will blend AI efficiency with human empathy—machines for tasks, people for connection.

punchline.text: Robots, AI, space stations. But a warm welcome still matters most.

quiz.question: What is still the #1 factor in guest satisfaction despite technology?
